caveats: Requires Paseo 0.11.4 or later and its web client; native mobile rendering is not enabled.
Pele has its own Mermaid syntax coverage and layout; it is not pixel-identical to Mermaid.
Mixed Gen-UI and diagram blocks may be claimed by another timeline transformer; use separate messages.
Surrounding Markdown uses a limited renderer; built-in file previews and all tool-output widgets are not replaced.
